# CERTIFICATE OF ASSISTANT SECRETARY

The undersigned, being the Assistant Secretary of FDS Holdings, Inc., a Delaware Corporation

(the &Company), does hereby certify as follows:

- John Rubinetti is an authorized signatory of the Company.
- John Rubinetti has the authority to negotiate and execute contracts on behalf of the Company.
